Okay! Imagine you have a favorite superhero. Some things you hear about them are true, like they really saved a cat from a tree. But other things you hear, like they can fly without wings, might be stories people made up to make them sound even cooler!

Joan of Arc was a real girl who lived a long time ago. She helped her country by telling soldiers what to do in a war. People say she heard voices from saints and wore armor to fight. Some of those things really happened—she really did help in the war and really did wear armor.

But other things people say about her, like always being perfect or having magic powers, are more like stories people tell to make her seem extra special. So, some parts of Joan of Arc’s story are true, and some are like the fun parts of a story that grown-ups tell to make it more exciting!
